text: After weeks with the Sony WH-1000XM5, I'm honestly blown away. The noise cancellation is almost magic. Little microphones listen to the noise around you and a processor makes a sound wave that's exactly opposite, so they hit together and calm down. On a train, the hum of the engine disappears and chatter becomes just a distant, muffled dream. The sound is rich and detailed, and they fit so well. Soft ear cups, really secure. Pros: fantastic ANC, comfortable, easy controls, killer battery. Battery lasts forever, and a short charge gets you hours. The transparency mode is actually quite natural, so I can hear announcements. Case is slim. Cons? Pressure can feel weird at first. The app can be temperamental. They're expensive. Also, ANC is best at low, steady noise; sudden voices still creep through. My verdict: if you want focus, they're worth it. Five stars.
